en: Black‑and‑white panorama of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the center stands a large Catholic church with two tall spires and a domed main nave, surrounded by several institutional-looking buildings and clustered houses. To the right is an industrial complex with long factory halls and a tall smokestack. Farm fields and scattered trees fill the foreground and rolling hills stretch into the distance.
